Superior Performance Line

Black Dragon

The menace of the Superior line. Black armor, a red dragon, and a heavy asymmetric read that scores for years.

The Superior Performance Line is the pinnacle of SWAG’s innovation: our finest asymmetric cores paired with advanced coverstocks. Leading it is the Black Dragon, an R&D favorite for its performance on the lanes.

With its striking black-and-red design and bold Dragon logo, the Black Dragon is built to leave a lasting impression and to dominate for years. This is the cornerstone the whole Superior line was built on.

Who It Is Built For

Match It To Your Game

Speed Dominant (Speed > Revs)

The Black Dragon sets the standard for higher-speed players who struggle for consistent motion. Its Dragon core (2.48 RG, .054 diff, .018 MB) delivers power usually found in higher-priced balls, and the Scorch cover adds strength and control, a predictable heavy-oil read you can trust.

Balanced (Speed = Revs)

Balanced players stay with the Black Dragon longer than other strong balls in league play. The Scorch cover and Dragon core are built for versatility, letting you adapt your angles as the lane transitions and stay with your first ball out of the bag even on fresh oil.

Rev Dominant (Revs > Speed)

Rev players who fight too much forward roll from over-shaped asymmetric cores get the answer here. The Dragon core mirrors a symmetric shape with a larger intermediate differential, so you get exceptional heavy-oil performance without losing control or predictability.

The Asymmetric Core

Dragon Asymmetric Core

The Dragon Asymmetric Core is the heart of the Superior line. At 15 lb it measures 2.48 RG, .054 differential, and a .017 mass bias: a strong, early-revving asymmetric shape that delivers flagship-level power and drive.

It is engineered to solve the problem rev players have with over-shaped asymmetric cores. By mirroring the overall shape of a symmetric core while carrying a larger intermediate differential, the Dragon core gives you heavy-oil power and continuation without giving up control or predictability.

The Coverstock

Scorch Solid

Scorch is the Dragon line’s cover, and the solid formulation is its strongest, earliest read. It grabs the midlane on heavy oil and stays with a predictable, controllable shape.

At a 1500 grit sanded finish it is built to read fresh, heavier patterns with authority, tuned for consistent, predictable motion rather than simply more hook. USBC approved.

Ball Care

Keep It Lethal

  • Wipe the cover with a microfiber towel between shots and clean it with an approved reactive ball cleaner after every session.
  • The box finish is 1500 grit sanded. Refresh the surface when the midlane read starts to lengthen, and leave surface changes to your pro shop.
  • The Black Dragon is sold undrilled. Have it drilled by a certified pro shop and match the layout to your game.

How to measure

These are measurements of the jersey laid flat, not of your body. The most reliable way to pick a size is to measure a shirt you already like wearing and match it to the table.

  1. Width. Lay the shirt flat and measure straight across from one underarm seam to the other.
  2. Length. Measure from the highest point of the shoulder, next to the collar, straight down to the hem.

A variance of up to 0.75 inches from the chart is normal on a printed-to-order garment.
